response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount - spent) AS overall_avg FROM budget) SELECT b.event_status AS status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS average_left_over, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) - o.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall FROM budget AS b CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.event_status
